title: Aleksandr named to the Future Stars National Team
body: Aleksandr's hard work paid off at the 2021 Future Stars National Championships, where he earned a place on the USA Gymnastics Future Stars National Team for 11-year-olds.

title: First place at Regional Future Stars
body: Aleksandr took first place at the 2019 Regional Future Stars and was named to the Region 6 Development Team for 9-year-olds.

title: New England Championships 2016
body: Aleksandr won the all-around silver in Class 4, with gold on high bar and a share of gold on vault. Cameron placed fourth all-around in Class 5.
